text.p: Italian bond futures slipped back in late afternoon in very quiet pre-Christmas trade with some profit-taking being seen after no interest rate cut emerged following last week's inflation numbers, dealers said.
They also noted some disappointment after Italian employers rejected the compromise solution put forward by the government to try and help end the on-going pay dispute with metal and

Analysts have estimated Italian Dec CPI inflation at 2.5-2.6 percent year on year based on preliminary data from 10 sample cities published last Thursday and Friday, after a 2.6 percent rate in November, but hopes for an interest rate cut late on Friday did not materialise.
Dealers noted that the parliamentary lower house finally passed Italy's 1997 62.5 trillion lire deficit-cutting budget package on a rare sitting of the house on Sunday.
